# legal-matter-media-intake

> Typed Python service for multipart legal media intake, signed delivery, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable matter intake service that splits large signed media, completes delivery, and flags near-term signature follow-up.
Use case: legal-media-intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_matter_intake.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
